extDescription.message: Adds a native-looking picture-in-picture button to the YouTube player. Watch in an always-on-top window over other tabs and apps.

hotkeyHint.message: Press P on YouTube to open or close

footer.message: Drag the window anywhere, resize it from its edges.

pauseWhenHidden.message: Pause while a full-screen app hides the window

pauseWhenHiddenHint.message: Resumes as soon as the window is visible again

fullscreenAppsNote.message: macOS never shows a browser window over another app's full-screen space, so the video keeps playing out of sight there. Tip: enlarge apps with Fill (⌥ + green button) instead of Full Screen and the window stays on top.
